title: The Cloud of Unknowing
author: Anonymous (Underhill ed)
description: An anonymous medieval guide to contemplative prayer that approaches God through love beyond discursive thought. Edited by Evelyn Underhill, it remains a central work in the Christian tradition of unknowing.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/bookofcontemplat00unde).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
